import json
from solution import solve

data = json.load(open('tests/expected.json'))
cases = data['cases']
pass_count = 0
fail_count = 0
for inp, expected in cases.items():
    xs = json.loads(inp)
    got = solve(xs)
    ok = (got == expected)
    if ok:
        pass_count += 1
    else:
        fail_count += 1
        print(f'FAIL {inp}: got {got}, expected {expected}')
print(f'PASS={pass_count} FAIL={fail_count}')
